def step(w,l,s):
    # orthog via QR
    V=np.array([l**j for j in range(s+1)]).T

    p=np.linalg.solve(R[:s,:s],-R[:s,s]); p=np.r_[p,1.]

for s in [2,3]:

l=np.array([-b,-c,-a,a,c,b]); powers=np.array([l,l*l,l**3])
def make(u,rho,eps=1e-4,x=0.,bal=.2):

    coeff=H.inv()*rhs

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import root
K=3

def mul(a,b):
 out=np.zeros(np.broadcast_shapes(a.shape,b.shape))
 for j in range(K+1):
  for i in range(j+1):out[j]+=a[i]*b[j-i]
 return out

def div(a,b):
 out=np.zeros(np.broadcast_shapes(a.shape,b.shape))
 for j in range(K+1):out[j]=(a[j]-sum((b[i]*out[j-i] for i in range(1,j+1)),start=np.zeros_like(a[j])))/b[0]
 return out
one=np.array([1.,0,0,0])
def step(w):
 m1=w@l;m2=w@(l*l);m3=w@(l**3)
 al=div(mul(m1,m2)-m3,m2-mul(m1,m1));be=-m2-mul(al,m1)
 p=one[:,None]*l[None,:]**2+al[:,None]*l[None,:]+be[:,None]
 wp=mul(w,mul(p,p));return div(wp,wp.sum(axis=1)[:,None])

def setup(p,q,F,sel):
 global l,la,li,Inv,L,M,pall,lo,hi
 pp=np.polymul(p,q);pp[-1]-=F;la=np.sort(np.roots(pp))
 pp[-1]+=2*F;allin=np.sort(np.roots(pp));li=allin[list(sel)]
 if max(abs(la.imag).max(),abs(li.imag).max())>1e-8:return False
 la=la.real;li=li.real;l=np.r_[la,li];pall=np.polyval(p,l);L=p[1]-q[1];M=p[2]-q[2]
 if abs(L)<1e-5:return False
 Mat=np.array([np.ones(4),la,pall[:4],la*pall[:4]]);Inv=np.linalg.inv(Mat)
 base=Inv@np.array([1,0,0,0]);d=Inv@np.array([0,1,0,0]);lo=max(-base[d>0]/d[d>0]);hi=min(-base[d<0]/d[d<0]);return lo<hi

def ode(state,extra=False):
 t,r=state[:2];z=state[2:];n=len(l)
 w=np.zeros((4,n));w[0,:4]=Inv@np.array([1,t,0,0]);w[1,:4]=Inv@np.array([0,0,r,(-1-M*r)/L]);w[2,4:]=z
 w[2,:4]=Inv@(-np.array([np.sum(z),z@li,z@pall[4:],z@(li*pall[4:])]))
 g=step(step(w));unew=g@pall;vnew=g@(l*pall);enew=-L*vnew-M*unew;e2=enew[2]
 res=np.r_[g[1]@l,unew[2]-r*e2,g[3,4:]-2*z*e2]
 return (res,-e2) if extra else res

rng=np.random.default_rng(4)
for F in [.05,.2,.5,1,2]:
 for sel in [(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3)]:
  p=[1,1,-2];q=[1,-2,-3]
  if not setup(p,q,F,sel):continue
  roots=[]
  for j in range(10):
   x=np.r_[rng.uniform(lo,hi),rng.normal(),np.exp(rng.uniform(-4,0,2))]
   so=root(ode,x)
   if so.success and np.linalg.norm(ode(so.x))<1e-5 and lo<so.x[0]<hi and min(so.x[2:])>0 and not any(np.linalg.norm(so.x-y)<1e-3 for y in roots):
    roots.append(so.x)
    J=np.column_stack([(ode(so.x+np.eye(4)[j]*1e-5)-ode(so.x-np.eye(4)[j]*1e-5))/2e-5 for j in range(4)])
    print('FOUND',F,sel,so.x,'decay',ode(so.x,True)[1],'eigs',np.linalg.eigvals(J),flush=True)
